Horizon.AnimalQuery: SELECT CAST(a.AniId AS nvarchar(64)) AS AnimalId, CAST(ISNULL(a.AniUserNumber, 0) AS int) AS CollarNumber, a.AniLifeNumber AS EarTag, CAST(CASE WHEN a.AniActive = 1 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS bit) AS IsGone, l.LocName AS Location, g.GroName AS [Group], a.AniDescription AS Description FROM dbo.HemAnimal a LEFT JOIN dbo.SytLocation l ON l.LocId = a.AniLocId LEFT JOIN dbo.HemGroup g ON g.GroId = a.AniGroId WHERE a.AniDeleted = 0
